draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for getting back to me. Your notification badge ticket is still open with our support team, and Tariq will keep you posted in that thread.

On the setup side, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project in place is usually the thing that makes everything else click. Happy to walk through it with you on a short call this week if that's useful -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Priya
